BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Junior Dragon Zyvio!!
W-what is this?!\nDid the villagers build this?
The materials are ours, but...\nWe don't build this kind of bizarre building.
Y-yeah, you're right.\nI think we'll find out about it if we go inside.\nEveryone, be careful!
A d-dragon?!
Oh, it's Eumanos the trashy veggies!\nI see you're here to rescue your friends...
But despite your number, you're still weak! You're\nnot going any further than this, you trashy\nveggies! Just rot and die in this arena!!
Oh, so stupid big bluffers do exist in this world\ntoo!
Aight then, lemme show you how scary a merchant\ngirl and an adventurer from another world can be!!
D-defeating me means nothing...\nWe have occupied the village...You won't be able\nto retrieve it w-with your power...
Oh, c'mon!! Pull yourselves together!
B-but...the dragon said they had occupied the\nvillage...
Don't be upset because of what a dying monster\nsaid! The village may have been occupied, but he\ndidn't say anything about the villagers!!
He didn't say that everyone is dead or has become\nmonsters, did he?! That means everyone is still\nalive and is waiting for y'all to rescue them!!
Aight, let's all go rescue the villagers!!
Okay!!
Phew~, I'm a merchant, you know?\nMotivating the Eumanos should be your job!\nC'mon, know your role!
